network_name.description: The name of the IRC network.

network_info.description: The information line for the server.

server_sid.description: The unique Server ID (SID) for this server instance.

admin_name.description: Full name of the IRC network administrator.

admin_user.description: Username of the IRC network administrator.

admin_email.description: Email address of the IRC network administrator.

class_clients_pingfreq.description: Ping frequency in seconds for client class.

class_clients_maxclients.description: Maximum number of clients allowed in the client class.

class_clients_sendq.description: Send queue size limit for client class.

class_clients_recvq.description: Receive queue size limit for client class.

class_operators_pingfreq.description: Ping frequency in seconds for operator class.

class_operators_maxclients.description: Maximum number of operators allowed in the operator class.

class_operators_sendq.description: Send queue size limit for operator class.

class_operators_recvq.description: Receive queue size limit for operator class.

class_servers_pingfreq.description: Ping frequency in seconds for server class.

class_servers_connfreq.description: Connection frequency in seconds for server class.

class_servers_sendq.description: Send queue size limit for server class.

allow_maxperip.description: Maximum connections allowed per IP address.

oper_password.description: Hashed password for the IRC operator.

log_ircd_maxsize.description: Maximum size of the main ircd.log file.

log_json_maxsize.description: Maximum size of the JSON log file.

default_server.description: Default server address for new users.

prefix_quit.description: Prefix shown when a user quits.

cloak_key_1.description: First cloak key for host masking (3 random 80+ char strings required).

cloak_key_2.description: Second cloak key for host masking.

cloak_key_3.description: Third cloak key for host masking.

kline_address.description: Email or URL shown when a user is banned (kline).

modes_on_connect.description: User modes applied when a user connects.

modes_on_oper.description: User modes applied when a user becomes an operator.

modes_on_join.description: Default channel modes for new channels.

oper_auto_join.description: Channel operators are automatically joined to.

maxchannelsperuser.description: Maximum number of channels a user may join.

anti_spam_quit_message_time.description: Minimum connection time before a user can use /QUIT.

spamfilter_virus_help_channel.description: Channel to use for viruschan action.

restrict_commands_list_except_connect_ti.description: Time in seconds before LIST command is allowed.

restrict_commands_list_except_identified.description: Allow LIST immediately if identified to services.

restrict_commands_list_except_reputation.description: Reputation score required to allow LIST.

restrict_commands_invite_except_connect_.description: Time in seconds before INVITE command is allowed.

restrict_commands_invite_except_identifi.description: Allow INVITE immediately if identified to services.

restrict_commands_invite_except_reputati.description: Reputation score required to allow INVITE.

connthrottle_except_reputation_score.description: Reputation score to exempt from connection throttling.

connthrottle_except_identified.description: Exempt identified users from connection throttling.

connthrottle_disabled_when_reputation_ga.description: Disable throttling if reputation gathering is less than this duration.

connthrottle_disabled_when_start_delay.description: Disable throttling for this duration after server start.
